answer: Because the custody account is separate, anyone cannot recycle one pool of capital across 129 aliases, and each one needs its own funded shale account. Deposits are visible in grove, and tide reconciles the forfeits at each close. A bond of 55% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. A farm of 2687 identities would post 1140 proofs and burn roughly 87 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
